summary: Converts RGB image data into HSV color space, where R becomes hue, G becomes saturation, and B becomes value.
common_gotchas: This TOP has no RGB-to-HSV page parameters; most control comes from common TOP settings.
Hue/saturation/value are packed into RGB channels, so downstream nodes must interpret channels accordingly.
Channel Mask can limit which channels are processed.
Pixel format choice matters for precision and color range.
Pair with HSV to RGB TOP when doing color adjustments in HSV space.
key_concepts: Converts RGB image data into HSV color space.
Hue, saturation, and value are packed into the output R, G, and B channels.
The official RGB to HSV page has no operator-specific parameters.
Common TOP controls still define output resolution, channel mask, and pixel format.
